name: Representation-Map Ample Classes Are Contained in Rooted Face-Consistent Coupling Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Representation-Map Ample Classes belongs to Rooted Face-Consistent Coupling Classes.
proof: An ordinary witness is a point-mass rooted selection satisfying every cube budget. The simultaneous sample constraints weaken as their dimension bound decreases, and every admissible mean is a full fractional allocation.
